title: Mother with Son and Daughter in Yard, 1962 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A square snapshot with deckled edges stamped 'JUL • 62' on the top margin, capturing an intimate family moment outside a suburban home. A smiling mother embraces her young daughter and son on a bright, sunny day. The boy playfully squints against the sunlight with a broad grin and hand on his hip, wearing a casual white t-shirt and cuffed denim jeans. The daughter wears a gingham short-sleeve shirt, while their mother wears a patterned summer top. The background features house siding, a large window, and a decorative garden planter fashioned from a vintage wooden wagon wheel.
